name: Void
title: voideditor.com
payoff: The open source AI code editor
shortDescription: Void is an open-source AI-powered code editor designed for developers seeking enhanced coding efficiency. It integrates AI features like Quick Edit and Chat directly into the coding environment, leveraging the power of VS Code. Ideal for software developers, Void supports various language models, offering flexibility in coding practices. An example use case is a developer using Void's Agent Mode to streamline code reviews and debugging processes.
pros: Features like Quick Edit and Chat
cons: May require familiarity with VS Code
Limited information on privacy and data security
